name: Speedster SR+ frameset
claimed_frame_weight_basis: Size 54, unpainted, excluding paint and metal hardware

editorial.verdict: The SR+ is the premium Speedster: the same unusually broad 1× tire envelope and six-size aero platform, paired with the lighter 720 g claim, higher-grade lay-up and titanium hardware at CNY 18,800.
best_for: lightweight aero road and rough-road versatility
premium frameset buyer prioritizing the top Speedster lay-up
strengths: Up to 38C slick or 36C small-knob tire clearance with 1×
AEROWAV integrated cockpit, aero seatpost and 3D-printed titanium parts included
caveats: A 2× drivetrain reduces the official maximum to 32C slick tires
The 720 g claim excludes paint and metal hardware
The 181 N/mm bottom-bracket stiffness figure is a manufacturer result without a published independent protocol
The CNY 6,000 premium over SR buys claimed weight, lay-up and hardware differences rather than a different geometry or clearance envelope
Independent long-term ride, quality-control and crash-replacement evidence remains limited

purchase_route: Official INCOLOR Taobao listing or a mainland dealer listed by the manufacturer
included: seatpost clamp, saddle clamp and front-derailleur mount
bottle-cage screws, computer mount, stem cap and UDH hanger
